properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-family hash library declared as a dependency in package-lock.json. Part of the shipped dependency inventory; SHA-2/SHA-3 hashes are PQ-resistant (Grover only halves security), so this is a posture note, not a PQ migration item.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 elliptic-curve library (node bindings + TypeScript types) declared as a devDependency and exercised in test/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.test.js to validate the Solidity ECDSA library against a reference secp256k1 implementation. Quantum-vulnerable under Shor; test-only here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey is the legacy OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey KDF (MD5-based) shipped as a dependency; PQ-irrelevant but a weak/legacy KDF to note in the dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test helper RSASigningKey: Node crypto.generateKeyPairSync('rsa', {modulusLength: 2048 default}) at line 113, then PKCS#1 v1.5 signing of a SHA-256 DigestInfo via privateEncrypt (lines 124-131), used to exercise the ERC-7913 RSA verification path in account tests. RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 — Shor-vulnerable signature with legacy padding; test-only asset.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 curve reference in package-lock.json metadata — same logical asset as the secp256k1/@types/secp256k1 dependency entries in ALG-673c8f24 (a grep confirms the only secp256k1 occurrences in the lockfile are those five lines).

components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (at least Node.js 22.12)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Release-workflow CI check: fetch() to https://registry.npmjs.com (isPublishedOnNpm, state.js:110) on Node.js >= 22.12 default TLS settings — negotiates TLS 1.3 with X25519 (or P-256) key exchange, no ML-KEM hybrid group offered. Harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to CI release traffic. Group selection is decided by the Node/OpenSSL runtime vendor, not this call site; observable here, replaceable upstream (OpenSSL 3.5+ ML-KEM hybrid groups).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256r1 ECDSA exercised by test/utils/cryptography/P256.test.js against the production P256.sol implementation, driven by the Wycheproof ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256_p1363 vector set (the JSON "curve" sites are vector-table metadata feeding that real verification run). Shor-vulnerable; the production call sites are reported separately as contract findings (P256.sol, WebAuthn.sol).

PQ-resistant (Grover-only); production Keccak use is reported separately in contracts findings.
